## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature (minor version bump)
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix (patch version bump)
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation only
- [ ] `style`: Formatting, no code change
- [ ] `refactor`: Code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvement
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance tasks

## Checklist

- [ ] I have tested these changes locally
- [ ] The build passes (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Content changes have been reviewed for both EN and FR translations
- [ ] No sensitive information is exposed

**Semantic Release Note:** Use [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) format:
- `feat: add products page` → triggers minor release (1.1.0)
- `fix: correct typo in hero` → triggers patch release (1.0.1)
- `feat!: redesign homepage` → triggers major release (2.0.0)
